note: Modeled river-channel centerline for Nolin River Lake, used to generate an approximate depth surface (not a survey). Points anchor to verified locations (USACE gauge at the dam, KY State Parks GNIS coordinate, Census TIGER geocodes for Dog Creek and Wax) with the channel path and depth/width values between them modeled on typical dendritic-reservoir geometry. Coverage is the main lake body and the two major arms with verified access points (Dog Creek, Wax) - it does not extend into the narrow upper river arm, where data confidence drops off.
modeled_max_depth_note: ~69 ft at the dam (USGS benchmark 446 ft, surveyed pre-dam elevation at Kyrock/Dismal Rock right at the dam gorge, vs 515 ft summer pool). Depths upstream of the dam are read from the 1954 Dickeys Mills / 1953 Bee Spring pre-dam USGS topo sheets against the 1966 post-dam 515' shoreline - see SESSION_NOTES.md for the full method and confidence notes per point. Revised down significantly from the original guessed profile now that real elevation data is available; published lake statistics vary source to source, treat as an approximation.
